attributes.mlflow.spanInputs: {"question": "Can I change the email address my invoices go to?"}
attributes.mlflow.spanOutputs:
"Yes. You can change the email your invoices go to in the Acme Cloud app:

1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Billing contact**.
2. Enter the new email address and save.

Invoices are PDFs you can download from **Settings → Billing → Invoices**."
